original.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 schema of pushsecrets.external-secrets.io, the value "v1" was removed from the allowed values of spec.template.engineVersion, and a resource using that removed value is rejected by the API server.

decision.reason: The two CRD bundles [ev-9889c9b8706d] and [ev-e08924afdc47] were compared by deterministic validators. They confirm that spec.template.engineVersion exists in the external-secrets.io PushSecret schema in both releases. They also confirm that its v1alpha1 enum lost "v1" and nothing was added. Removing an allowed enum value makes the schema reject values it used to accept, so validation-tightened with before "v1" is correct. Setting version=v1alpha1 is justified because the change is limited to the v1alpha1 schema.
